overview: Based on the published agenda, the D.C. Everest Area School District was scheduled to hold its annual budget hearing and seventy-seventh annual school district meeting on October 28, 2026. The meeting was expected to address the proposed 2026-2027 budget, set the school tax levy, establish board salaries and expense reimbursement policies, and conduct other routine annual business.

agenda.item: Announce Purpose of the Budget Hearing [State Statute, Section 65.90(4)]
Call to Order (Seventy-Seventh Annual School District Meeting)
Reading of Office Notice of Meeting
Announce Robert's Rules of Order to Prevail
Provide for Reimbursement of School Board Expenses as per Bylaw 0144.1
Set Time and Place of the 2027 Annual Meeting

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to review the proposed 2026-2027 budget using the required published budget summary format. The meeting included a designated period for questions and comments from the public regarding the budget proposal.
District officials were expected to present and seek approval of the treasurer's report as part of routine annual meeting business.
The board was scheduled to establish compensation levels for school board members for the 2026-2027 fiscal year.

discussions.item: Provide for Reimbursement of School Board Expenses as per Bylaw 0144.1
discussions.body: The board was expected to review and establish reimbursement policies for school board member expenses in accordance with district policy Bylaw 0144.1.
The board was scheduled to establish the tax levy for the 2026-2027 school year as part of the annual meeting business.

discussions.item: Set Time and Place of the 2027 Annual Meeting
discussions.body: The board was expected to designate the date, time, and location for the 2027 annual meeting.

publicComment: A questions and comments period was included on this agenda following the review of the proposed 2026-2027 budget.
actionItems: Board was expected to adopt the 2026-2027 budget
Board was expected to set school board salaries for 2026-2027
Board was expected to approve reimbursement policies for school board expenses per Bylaw 0144.1
Board was expected to set the 2026-2027 tax levy
Board was expected to approve the treasurer's report
Board was expected to establish the time and place for the 2027 annual meeting
title: Annual Meeting/Budget Hearing - 2026-10-28
